entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Supervised and unsupervised learning with SciPy and ScikitLearn
Large language models and generative AI
Natural language processing and computer vision
reading.format: Delivered as a 13-course series with hands-on labs and projects. The page mentions practical evaluations and says 19 languages are available.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 13-course professional certificate from IBM on Coursera. It covers AI engineering skills such as machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and large language models. The program includes hands-on labs and projects. Completing it is presented as demonstrating expertise and practical experience for AI engineering roles.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists who want to become job-ready AI engineers. It is listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
